problem: T-7d4006bda247ba-01 (textiles_laundry__examples.json) fails in its own mode on seeds 0 and 41 ('damage'): the iron set upright on its heel rest scorches the ironing board. The only failing authored spec (242/243 in own mode on the integrated tree).

problem: Pouring from a closed trigger sprayer or pump head pours its contents (0.75 l), unlike every closed container.
cause: house_sim/systems/plumbing_liquids/transfer.py checks only openable sources (~line 664: 'Open it first'); a trigger or pump head is closed for the kernel (phys.liquids.container_closed). Cleaning's phase-1 request.

problem: Spills and splashes from plumbing's own verbs never reach the kernel's wetting hooks: electrical gear on the counter gets wet with no phys.wetted, so its ground fault and the attribution of what follows are missed (T-686df131c7c736-01 seed 1: the coffee maker, microwave and toaster reach wetness 0.5, circuit_breaker_1 trips 8 s later and the fridge's power loss reads as exogenous).
cause: house_sim/systems/plumbing_liquids/common.py wet() writes w.mut(eid)['wetness'] directly (electrical's request).
change: Route the wetting through house_sim.kernel.phys.liquids.wet(w, eid, liters, liquid, source=...) (phys.wetted hooks run; the film model applies).

problem: Dumping a bucket onto a food item 'empties' the litres into the food (liquid_in_bin_l, leaking) and the liquid vanishes: nothing wets or runs off.
cause: transfer.dest_kind returns 'bin' for any record with a waste_stream, and food entities carry waste_stream (the stream they go to when discarded). Food's phase-1 request.
change: A bin is a container (accepts_items) with a waste_stream whose own category is not food: test rec.get('accepts_items') or rec.get('container') before 'bin'. Repro: tests/test_food.py scene([spawn bread_slice on {counter}, helper plumbing_liquids.dirty_bucket ...]) then plumbing_liquids.dump container={bucket} dest={slice}.

problem: Two door-dash draws when the robot opens a door while the pets domain is loaded (mechanisms' closures._door_dash at after-open order 50 and pets' behavior._door_opened at 60), and mechanisms' escapes reach pets without mechanisms' attribution (it corrects stats.pet_escape after the call).
cause: house_sim/systems/mechanisms/closures.py _door_dash (~line 313, called on every door opening) does not stand down when pets is loaded (world.pets_own_escapes already does for the time-driven escapes), and closures.escape (~line 659) calls pets.escape(w, pid, room, via=via) without robot= (pets' phase-1 requests 1 and 2; pets now takes robot= and owns the dash while loaded).

problem: The domain's stack explanation disagrees with the kernel's stack law (a mixing bowl on a kitchen scale's platform is stable for the kernel, oversize for manipulation's stack_reason), so the stack law is not ready to flip (D1).

problem: An unfamiliar (novel) thing is told apart by take_photo: a smartphone answers 'Nobody to photograph here', every other unfamiliar thing 'That is not a camera' (review I4; phase-1 red team red_leaks finding 5; the upgraded perception auditor reports it as a twin leak in both camera modes, so G4 fails until it is fixed).
cause: house_sim/systems/people/social.py take_photo (~line 345) checks the true type before anything else. The kernel now refuses every action registered with operates=True on a thing the robot takes for an unfamiliar thing (actions.NOVEL_OPERATE_MESSAGE, engine.step, before any domain hook; FIX2), but take_photo is not declared operates.
change: Register take_photo with operates=True (@action(..., operates=True)); the kernel then answers one refusal for every unfamiliar target. Repro: python tools/perception_audit.py 1 20 --workers 4 --verbose (twin leak 'novel electric_kettle vs smartphone at take_photo'); tests/test_kernel_redteam.py UnfamiliarThingTests shows the core verbs.

problem: An unfamiliar (novel) thing is told apart by pull_handle / push_handle (only the kettle opens: 'Pulled obj open to 100%' vs 'Nothing here opens by pulling') and press (review I4; phase-1 red team novel sweep, twins_generic.py novel_sweep --sweep).
cause: house_sim/systems/mechanisms/handles.py pull_handle / push_handle and controls.py press act by the true type of an unidentified unfamiliar thing; they are not declared operates=True, so the kernel's novel-thing refusal (FIX2: actions.NOVEL_OPERATE_MESSAGE) does not reach them. This is also the 'operation rule' mechanisms asked the kernel for: the kernel decided unfamiliar things are moved and inspected, not operated (docs/PERCEPTION.md).
change: Register pull_handle, push_handle and press (and any other verb that works a device or mechanism) with operates=True. Repro: the red team's twins_generic.py novel_sweep --sweep (scratch p1_red_leaks/id) or a twin of tests/test_kernel_redteam.py UnfamiliarThingTests with these verbs.

cause: house_sim/systems/food/actions_measure.py checks openable / open of the true record of a target the robot cannot identify (the kernel's glance no longer shows openable for unfamiliar things: realism.NOVEL_FIELDS, FIX2).
change: Declare these container verbs operates=True (the kernel refuses an unfamiliar target alike), or check ctx.unresolved(target) first with one generic refusal. Repro: twins_generic.py novel_sweep --sweep (scratch p1_red_leaks/id).

problem: An unfamiliar (novel) thing is told apart by fill (source: 'Hold the container you are pouring from' for the kettle and the bleach jug vs 'That is not a water or liquid source') (review I4; phase-1 red team novel sweep).

problem: An unfamiliar (novel) thing is told apart by empty_into: the bleach jug 'You cannot pour that there' vs 'Emptied ...' for every other unfamiliar thing as target, and 'Open the lid of obj first' for the kettle as destination (review I4; phase-1 red team novel sweep).

problem: T-5a9598c809336a-01 (tools_vehicles__perception.json) now fails on every seed: its wrong plan 'looks the bench over from where it stands and reports every tool fine...' starts with {"do": "look", "around": true}, which look never accepts ('Unknown parameter for look: around'); its inspects and reports are refused too, so the plan never performs its mistake. The verifier's interim rule (FIX2, VERIFY_HARDENING 14.3 rule 1 in advance) counts a step refused for its form as not evidence.

problem: Lift monotonicity still breaks for damp or wet surfaces: a damp item slips one-handed from 4.8 kg while the same item at 8.01 kg is held with two hands (phase-1 red team red_defects finding 8; outside PHYSICS.md 8's 'clean, dry' contract, but the same planner-picks-a-lift-its-physics-fails class as H11 defect 1).
cause: house_sim/systems/manipulation/common.py grip_outcome: the adaptive one-hand cap is rated_squeeze_n (the rated DRY squeeze), below the hand's hardware limit (body.grip_limit_n, 150 N), so on a damp surface the grip the kernel's lift plan hands to one hand slips (6 kg damp: applied 52.3 N, required 65.4 N).
change: Let the adaptive one-hand grip rise to the hardware limit for the surface it actually grips (cap = min(body.grip_limit_n, max(rated dry squeeze, required x 1.3))), keeping the slip where even the hardware limit cannot hold; add a damp case to LiftMonotonicityTests. (The kernel's lift_plan keeps core pick_up's mass and size thresholds: changing its hand choice by surface would alter every wet-item pick-up.) Repro: probe_lift_damp.py and probe_lift.py 'damp surface' (scratch p1_red_defects).

problem: A second camera-dependent privacy count: looking into a bathroom through an open doorway (robot waiting in the hall facing it while someone showers) counts 1 with the geometric camera and 0 in room mode (phase-1 red team red_defects finding 9). Documented now (docs/KNOWN_LIMITS.md 6) and pinned as an expected difference (tests/test_kernel_contracts.py CameraModeHarmTests.test_a_private_moment_seen_through_a_doorway_is_one_violation_at_most).
cause: The people domain's room-mode privacy rule counts entries into a room with a private moment only; the geometric camera counts what it captures, through doorways too.
change: Before D3 makes geometric the default: count a doorway view of a private moment in room mode too (the robot in a room connected by an open doorway, facing it), or keep it as the documented expected difference. Repro: probe_privacy.py (scratch p1_red_defects) case 'showering in bath, robot waits in the hall facing the doorway'.
